questions.q: Ol Chiki powerful introduction to Santhali community, says President Murmu. Ol Chiki has completed how many years?

UPSC‑style fact sheet:

Script_Name = Ol Chiki (Ol Cemetʼ)

Inventor = Pandit Raghunath Murmu (1925)

Language = Santali (an Austroasiatic language of the Munda family)

Alphabet = 30 letters (designed specifically for Santali sounds)

Usage = Officially recognized in India; used in literature, education, and cultural identity preservation

questions.q: Piton de la Fournaise, where a second effusive eruption has recently. begun, is located on which island?
questions.explain:
Piton de la Fournaise:

Location = Réunion Island, Indian Ocean (French overseas territory)

Type = Shield Volcano (one of the most active in the world)

Height = ~2,632 meters above sea level

Last_Eruption = Frequent eruptions; latest in 2025 (non‑explosive, lava flows)

Significance = Major geological site, tourist attraction, and part of Réunion National Park (UNESCO World Heritage)

questions.q: Under PM Surya Ghar, households can receive subsidy up to INR ...
questions.explain:
Launch Year = 2024

Objective = Promote rooftop solar adoption for households; provide free electricity up to 150 units/month in some cases

Subsidy = Up to ₹78,000 (≈40% of installation cost) for residential consumers

Target = 4 million households by March 2026 (≈2.36 million joined so far)

Challenges = Loan paperwork delays, utility revenue concerns, slower progress than expected.
